Package main.java.progOO2.p17

package main.java.progOO2.p17

Programming Object Oriented II: Items

This package introduces objects that store both data and metadata (such as creation time) and demonstrates how collections of such objects can be managed through user input.

Classes:

  • Item: Represents a single item with a name and a timestamp createdAt. Its toString() method displays the name and formatted creation date.
  • Items: A program with a main method that asks the user for item names, creates Item objects, stores them in a list, and prints their details. Input stops when the user enters an empty string.

Key learning goals:

  • Encapsulation: Fields remain private, with access through methods like getName() and toString().
  • Timestamps: Use of LocalDateTime and DateTimeFormatter to record creation time.
  • Collections: Managing multiple objects in an ArrayList.
  • User interaction: Reading input with Scanner and stopping on an empty line.

Together, these classes help students practice building both simple data models and more complex object-collection interactions (like Item and Items).
